_doc: Medium batch m01 (Sonnet generic pass): family corrections only; colour/lift/snd left to the builder defaults.

orb-spider/f:b2.note: dew-beaded orb web screen: sparkle dew, not another web

fishing-spider/f:b0.note: minnow dive: splashing water drops instead of a plain slash

fishing-spider/f:b2.note: bristle legs guard: spiky leg bristles

golden-orb-weaver/f:b2.note: gilded silk sheet: gold glitter on the sheet

golden-orb-weaver/f:u0.note: silk wall that blocks: dash-scroll wall rather than a fourth web

golden-orb-weaver/f:u1.note: web dodge: dust puff of a quick sidestep

dune-scorpion/f:u3.note: sand shuffle: sand dust puffs (hold tag already used by Plate Up)

whip-scorpion/f:b0.note: whip-arm snip is a pincer snap; avoids a second slash beside Whip Lash

whip-scorpion/f:b2.note: keyword false match: vinegar starts with vine; it is a flat shell guard

giant-centipede/f:u2.note: coil up: rings of a coiling body

giant-centipede/f:u3.note: hundred steps raking claws; Hundred Legs keeps the buzz

cave-centipede/f:u3.note: roof drop: falls from the cave roof like dripping water (pierce already on Cave Strike)

giant-millipede/f:u2.note: poison mist is a cloud: puff, greenish by base tone

scarab-roller/f:u0.note: gold carapace shine, not a dust evade

ember-beetle/f:u3.note: scorched track: scorch keyword beats thorns tag visually; art-led

frost-beetle/f:u1.note: ice skate: glide ripples, differs from Ice-Skid Bowl shock

lava-beetle/f:b0.note: nip is the attack, scorch the track; bite+ember tie, best guess bite

lava-beetle/f:u2.note: ash cloud billows: puff, differs from Scorch Run ember
